# AdelIA v0.1 — M5 Briefing Generator (Modo B) Design

**Status:** approved post-brainstorm 2026-05-13.
**Predecessor specs:** `docs/specs/2026-05-05-adelia-v0.1-design.md` (overall v0.1 design, rev 2 — §7 Briefing schema).
**Successor:** `docs/plans/2026-05-13-adelia-v0.1-m5-briefing.md` (implementation plan, generated by writing-plans skill from this design).
**Author:** Santiago Patiño Serna + Claude Opus 4.7.

---

## 1. Goal

Ship the **Modo B** half of AdelIA's core product: a portable, opinionated 1-pager medical briefing per consultation, generated on-demand from the user's vault of FHIR-IPS entities, filtered by target specialty, citation-enforced, ready to share with any specialist.

M5 ships the **generation, persistence, and in-app preview** of the briefing. M6 will add **PDF render (WeasyPrint) and signed-URL sharing** on top of the same data + Jinja2 templates.

## 2. Non-goals (M5 explicit cuts)

- ❌ PDF render — deferred to M6 (Jinja2 template designed in M5 to be PDF-ready)
- ❌ Signed URL sharing service — deferred to M6
- ❌ QR widget / email-to-doctor — deferred to v0.1.1
- ❌ Clinician-verified provenance badge (🟢) — deferred to v0.2+
- ❌ Editing briefings post-generation — M5 UX is "regenerate from scratch" (cheap given polling architecture)
- ❌ LLM auto-detect specialty — dropdown-only (8 specialties + default) per brainstorm decision #2
- ❌ Low-confidence entity review UX — deferred to v0.1.1 (carry-over)

## 3. Brainstorm decisions (2026-05-13, 5 questions)

| # | Decision | Resolution | Rationale |
|---|----------|------------|-----------|
| 1 | Briefing generation flow | **Async + polling** | Generation takes 20-40s (5 LLM calls). Sync blocks UX; SSE is overkill for structured output. Polling pattern already exists for document processing (M1) — reusable. |
| 2 | Specialty selection UX | **Dropdown only (8 + default)** | Simpler, no LLM call, no ambiguity. Default rules are robust enough for unlisted specialties. LLM detect can be added in v0.1.1 if dropdown UX feedback warrants. |
| 3 | Cache invalidation on new doc upload | **Stale flag, no auto-regenerate** | Marks `is_stale=true` on user's existing briefings when a new doc is processed. UI shows warning banner. User decides if regenerate is warranted. Zero auto-cost, user control. |
| 4 | Q&A pre-baker count | **Fixed 5 questions** | One LLM call with structured output (array of 5). Deterministic test, simple prompt, matches spec rev 2 §7.4. If 5 are not relevant → user regenerates briefing. |
| 5 | Specialty templates v0.1 | **8 + default** | peds + endo + cardio + gineco + gastro + derm + general_medicine + default. JSON config, ~30 min to write all 8 files (static filter rules, not prompts). |

### Bonus decision (inherited from pre-existing draft plan)

| # | Decision | Resolution | Rationale |
|---|----------|------------|-----------|
| 6 | Briefing render strategy (in-app preview) | **Jinja2 server-side HTML render, shared with M6 WeasyPrint PDF** | Single source of truth for HTML/PDF layout. Frontend fetches sanitized HTML (via nh3) and renders it in a styled container. M6 reuses the same Jinja2 template + same CSS for WeasyPrint PDF output. DRY across briefing surfaces. |

## 4. Architecture

### High-level data flow

```
┌─ POST /briefings (encola async) ────────────────────────────────┐
│   1. Validate target_specialty ∈ enum                           │
│   2. briefing_repo.create_briefing(status='processing')         │
│   3. BackgroundTasks.add_task(orchestrator, briefing_id)        │
│   4. return 202 + {id, status: 'processing'}                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ briefing_orchestrator (BackgroundTask, 5-stage pipeline) ──────┐
│   1. Load entities + chunks scoped to user_id, deleted_at=NULL  │
│      (filtered by specialty filter rules — see §6.2)            │
│   2. sbar_formatter → BriefingPayload.sections (the 8)          │
│   3. qa_pre_baker → top-5 QA items + citations                  │
│   4. assemble_payload → BriefingPayload (validated Pydantic)    │
│   5. briefing_html_renderer → HTML string (Jinja2 + nh3)        │
│   6. briefing_repo.update_payload_html_status(...)              │
│        status='ready' OR status='failed' + error_message        │
│   finally: completed_at = now()  (always set, even on error)    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ GET /briefings/{id}  (polling) ─────────────────────────────────┐
│   Returns: { id, status, target_specialty, is_stale,            │
│              payload?, html?, created_at, completed_at }        │
│   If status='processing' → frontend continues polling every 2s  │
│   If status='ready' → renders html + interactive citations      │
│   If status='failed' → shows error_message + retry button       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Stale hook (integrated in process_document M1 pipeline) ───────┐
│   At end of process_document(doc_id):                            │
│      briefing_repo.mark_stale_for_user(user_id,                 │
│                                       since=new_doc.created_at) │
│   UPDATE briefings SET is_stale=TRUE                            │
│      WHERE user_id=:uid AND deleted_at IS NULL                  │
│      AND created_at < :since                                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Boundaries (units of M5)

```
M5 NEW units:
  - briefing_orchestrator   → coordinates 5-stage pipeline
  - sbar_formatter          → pure: entities → 8 sections
  - qa_pre_baker            → LLM call: top-5 QA with citations
  - briefing_html_renderer  → Jinja2 + nh3 sanitization
  - briefing_repo           → CRUD over briefings + citations tables
  - specialty_templates/    → JSON config (8 + default)
  - briefings router        → 4 endpoints

M5 REUSES (no rebuild):
  - mistral_client (singleton, M2/M3)
  - entity ORM model + queries (M2)
  - cross-user isolation pattern (M1 auth_dep + WHERE user_id)
  - BackgroundTasks pattern (M1 process_document)
  - TestClient route-level tests (M1+M3)
  - Pydantic Citation type concept (M3 chat citations)

M5 DOES NOT use:
  - RAG/pgvector retrieval (chat M3) — briefing is structured query, not vector search
  - chat_orchestrator (M3) — different concern (free-text streaming vs structured projection)
```

## 5. Data model additions

```sql
-- 5.1 Migration `0003_briefing_cols_citations`
ALTER TABLE briefings
  ADD COLUMN status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'processing'
    CHECK (status IN ('processing', 'ready', 'failed')),
  ADD COLUMN is_stale BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN error_message TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  ADD COLUMN html_render TEXT;  -- Jinja2-rendered HTML, sanitized, cached

-- briefings ya tenía (M1 schema): id, user_id, target_specialty, payload JSONB, created_at, deleted_at

CREATE INDEX idx_briefings_user_created ON briefings(user_id, created_at DESC)
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;  -- list endpoint perf

-- 5.2 New briefing_citations table — transversal provenance index
CREATE TABLE briefing_citations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  briefing_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES briefings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  entity_id UUID REFERENCES entities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  document_id UUID REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  section TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 'reason_for_consult' | 'allergies' | 'qa_pre_baker' | ...
  position INT NOT NULL,         -- order within section
  raw_quote TEXT NOT NULL,       -- verbatim, defense-in-depth (FKs SET NULL on cascade)
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_briefing_citations_briefing ON briefing_citations(briefing_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_briefing_citations_document ON briefing_citations(document_id);
```

### BriefingPayload Pydantic schema

```python
# apps/api/adelia/schemas.py — additions

class Specialty(str, Enum):
    PEDIATRICS = "pediatrics"
    ENDOCRINOLOGY = "endocrinology"
    CARDIOLOGY = "cardiology"
    GYNECOLOGY = "gynecology"
    GASTROENTEROLOGY = "gastroenterology"
    DERMATOLOGY = "dermatology"
    GENERAL_MEDICINE = "general_medicine"
    DEFAULT = "default"

class BriefingStatus(str, Enum):
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    READY = "ready"
    FAILED = "failed"

class Citation(BaseModel):
    document_id: UUID
    entity_id: UUID | None
    raw_quote: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    page: int | None = None

class QAItem(BaseModel):
    question: str
    answer: str
    citations: list[Citation]

class BriefingSections(BaseModel):
    reason_for_consult: str | None  # Optional patient-provided context
    active_problems: list[ProblemItem]
    medications: list[MedicationItem]
    allergies: list[AllergyItem] | Literal["no_known_allergies"]
    immunizations: list[ImmunizationItem] | None  # None if hidden by specialty filter
    procedures: list[ProcedureItem]
    family_history: list[FamilyHistoryItem] | None  # None if hidden
    relevant_observations: list[ObservationItem]   # labs + vitals + trends
    open_questions: list[QAItem]  # exactly 5

class BriefingPayload(BaseModel):
    schema_version: Literal["1.0"] = "1.0"
    generated_at: datetime
    target_specialty: Specialty
    patient: PatientHeader
    sections: BriefingSections
    applied_filter: AppliedFilter  # specialty + rules_version
    llm_meta: LLMMeta             # model, tokens, cost_estimate_usd
```

## 6. Specialty filter rules (config-driven)

### 6.1 Format

JSON file per specialty in `apps/api/adelia/specialty_templates/`:

```json
// pediatrics.json
{
  "specialty": "pediatrics",
  "rules_version": "1.0",
  "include_immunizations": true,
  "include_family_history": false,
  "highlight_growth_curves": true,
  "vital_emphasis": ["weight_percentile", "height_percentile", "head_circumference"],
  "highlight_observations": [],
  "exclude_observations": [],
  "qa_pre_baker_hints": "Pediatric specialist — focus on developmental milestones, immunization status, growth trends, infection history"
}
```

### 6.2 Filter rules application

Order: load entities → group by entity_type → apply specialty filter rules:

1. **Section hide/show**: `include_immunizations`, `include_family_history`, `include_social_history` toggles.
2. **Section reorder**: per spec §7.2 ranking table (universal default), with specialty bumping highlighted sections.
3. **Observations filter**: `highlight_observations` whitelist + `exclude_observations` blacklist for the `relevant_observations` section. Empty whitelist → use temporal heuristic (recent + relevant).
4. **Vital emphasis**: surfaces specific vitals at the top of `relevant_observations`.

### 6.3 8 templates shipped in v0.1

`pediatrics`, `endocrinology`, `cardiology`, `gynecology`, `gastroenterology`, `dermatology`, `general_medicine`, `default`.

### 6.4 Default fallback

Any specialty value passed not in the 8 enum → API rejects with 422. Frontend dropdown is the source of truth.

## 7. Q&A pre-baker prompt design

Single Mistral chat completion call with structured output (response_format=json_schema).

```
System: You are a clinical assistant generating pre-baked Q&A for a medical briefing.

User context: You are preparing a briefing for a patient about to see a {specialty} specialist.
The patient's data is provided below.

Generate exactly 5 questions a {specialty} specialist is most likely to ask in a 15-minute consultation.
For each question, provide an answer based ONLY on the patient data. Each answer MUST cite at least one
raw_quote from the source documents — verbatim, no paraphrasing.

CRITICAL ANTI-HALLUCINATION RULES:
- If patient data does not contain enough info to answer a question → answer "No data available in patient history"
- DO NOT invent diagnoses, medications, or values not present in the entities
- raw_quote MUST appear verbatim in one of the provided source quotes
- If you cannot generate 5 questions with grounded answers, generate fewer (minimum 3) — never fabricate

Specialty-specific guidance: {qa_pre_baker_hints}

Output JSON schema: {array of {question: string, answer: string, citations: [{document_id, entity_id, raw_quote}]}}

Patient data (entities + raw_quotes):
{rendered_entities_with_quotes}
```

### Anti-hallucination guard (post-LLM)

After LLM response:
1. Parse JSON. If schema fails → log + return empty QA array.
2. For each citation: assert `raw_quote` exists verbatim in the patient's `documents.raw_text` (any doc, any page). If not → drop the QA item with `logger.warning`.
3. If after filtering <3 items remain → return what we have (don't pad with hallucinated content).

## 8. HTML rendering (Jinja2 + nh3)

### 8.1 Template structure

```
apps/api/adelia/templates/
└── briefing/
    ├── briefing.html.j2         # main template (SBAR envelope + 8 sections + QA)
    ├── _sections/
    │   ├── reason_for_consult.html.j2
    │   ├── active_problems.html.j2
    │   ├── medications.html.j2
    │   ├── allergies.html.j2          # incl. "No known allergies" handling
    │   ├── immunizations.html.j2
    │   ├── procedures.html.j2
    │   ├── family_history.html.j2
    │   ├── relevant_observations.html.j2
    │   └── open_questions.html.j2
    └── _shared/
        ├── citation_badge.html.j2     # data-citation-id="..."
        ├── provenance_badge.html.j2   # 🟡 / 🟠
        └── disclaimer_footer.html.j2

apps/api/adelia/static/
└── briefing/
    └── briefing.css                   # CSS shared between HTML preview + PDF (M6)
```

### 8.2 Why nh3 (not bleach)

Rust-backed HTML sanitizer. The Jinja2 template includes LLM-generated `narrative` strings (assessment section, Q&A answers) which need stripping of any HTML the LLM might try to emit. `nh3.clean()` is significantly faster than Python's `bleach`, and is maintained by the Mozilla addons team.

### 8.3 Citation linking pattern

Each `Citation` rendered as `<sup data-citation-id="{citation.id}"><a href="/dashboard/documents/{doc_id}">{position}</a></sup>`. Frontend can attach click handler on `data-citation-id` attribute selector for interactivity (highlight source doc, scroll, etc.) without parsing the HTML payload — adds interactivity layer without breaking SSR.

## 9. Endpoints

```
POST   /briefings                   → 202 { id, status, target_specialty, created_at }
GET    /briefings                   → 200 [{ id, target_specialty, status, is_stale, created_at }]
GET    /briefings/{id}              → 200 { id, status, target_specialty, payload?, html?, is_stale, error_message?, created_at, completed_at? }
POST   /briefings/{id}/regenerate   → 202 { id, status: 'processing' } (creates a new briefing row, original stays accessible)
DELETE /briefings/{id}              → 204 (soft-delete via deleted_at)
```

Cross-user isolation: all routes use `Depends(get_current_user_id)` + WHERE user_id filter + 404 opaque on cross-user.

## 10. Stale flag hook

Implemented in `apps/api/adelia/workers/process_document.py` (M1 pipeline), at the success exit:

```python
async def process_document(doc_id: UUID, user_id: UUID) -> None:
    try:
        # ... existing pipeline (OCR → entity extract → chunker → embeddings)
        async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
            doc = await get_document(session, doc_id)
            doc.processed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            await briefing_repo.mark_stale_for_user(
                session,
                user_id=user_id,
                since=doc.created_at,
            )
            await session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        # ... existing error handling
        raise
```

Idempotent: if user uploads 5 docs in rapid succession, briefings get marked stale once per doc; final state is `is_stale=true` regardless of race conditions.

## 11. Testing strategy

| Layer | Tests | Pattern |
|-------|-------|---------|
| **Pure unit (sbar_formatter)** | 12+ tests with entity fixtures — covers: peds vs default difference, "No known X" rule, immunizations hide/show, ordering | No DB, no LLM, no API. Run on every commit. |
| **Pure unit (specialty_templates loader)** | JSON validation + enum coverage | Pure. |
| **Pure unit (briefing_html_renderer)** | Jinja2 render with fixture payload, asserts nh3 strips `<script>` from LLM output | Pure (no LLM, no DB). |
| **Live test gated (qa_pre_baker)** | 1 test with real Mistral, `@pytest.mark.skipif(not settings.mistral_api_key)` | TDD leaf worker pattern (M2-T2/T3 replica). |
| **RuntimeError test (qa_pre_baker)** | Monkeypatch client raises → assert wrapped exception | Always runs. |
| **Mocked orchestrator** | 3 tests with `@patch` AsyncMock on entity load + LLM call + repo update | M3-T6 chat_orchestrator pattern replica. |
| **PG-gated repo tests** | briefing_repo CRUD with real Postgres | `@pytest.mark.skipif(True, reason='PG required')` until env-var gating migration (v0.1.1). |
| **Endpoint route-level (TestClient)** | 8 tests via TestClient + monkeypatch: 202 shape, polling, 404 cross-user opaque, regenerate flow, stale hook fires, soft-delete | M1+M3 pattern. |

## 12. Acceptance criteria (M5 done)

- [ ] `scripts/m5-acceptance.sh` headless test passes (auth → upload doc → wait processing → POST briefing → poll until ready → GET briefing returns payload with 8 sections + 3-5 QA items (5 is target; anti-hallucination guard may filter to minimum 3) + ≥1 citation)
- [ ] `M5_ACCEPTANCE.md` frontend manual checklist passes (browser UI flow)
- [ ] Cross-user isolation: user A cannot GET briefing of user B → 404 opaque
- [ ] Specialty filter: peds briefing INCLUDES immunizations section; default briefing OMITS it
- [ ] "No known X" rule: user without allergies → allergy section shows "No known allergies" (not omitted)
- [ ] Provenance badges (🟡 extracted / 🟠 patient_stated) visible in HTML render
- [ ] Stale flag: upload new doc after briefing creation → existing briefing rows for user have `is_stale=true`
- [ ] Regenerate flow: stale banner → click regenerate → new briefing row created, status transitions processing → ready
- [ ] LLM disclaimer footer present in every briefing HTML
- [ ] Anti-hallucination guard: post-LLM filter drops QA items where `raw_quote` not in source `raw_text`
- [ ] Performance: briefing generation P95 ≤ 45s (target ≤30s, alarm if >45s for v0.1.1 optimization)
- [ ] Tag `v0.1-m5-rc1` created

## 13. Risks specific to M5

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|------|----------|------------|
| qa_pre_baker LLM invents questions / fabricates answers | **Critical** | System prompt forbids fabrication + post-LLM raw_quote verbatim check + drop QA items that fail. Hard threshold: minimum 3, never pad to 5 with synthetic content. |
| sbar_formatter omits required section (e.g., user has no allergies → section disappears) | High | Explicit test: user with no allergies → assert briefing payload contains `allergies: "no_known_allergies"`. Sections allergy/medication/condition are mandatory per IPS spec. |
| Briefing generation exceeds 60s BackgroundTask soft timeout | Medium | Log P95. If consistently >45s → flag for v0.1.1 optimization (cache embeddings, batch LLM calls, reduce QA from 5 to 3). |
| Stale flag race condition (briefing finishes simultaneously with new doc upload) | Low | Comparison `briefings.created_at < new_doc.created_at` resolves idempotently — the briefing IS stale w.r.t. the newer doc regardless of finish order. |
| LLM emits HTML in narrative strings (XSS via briefing render) | High | nh3 sanitization on every LLM-output field before storage. Defense-in-depth: Jinja2 autoescape on top. |
| Jinja2 template error mid-pipeline corrupts briefing row | Medium | Wrap render in try/except: status='failed' + error_message='render_failed: <msg>'. User retries via regenerate. |
| Postgres `briefing_citations` grows large (5 sections × 20 entities × N users) | Low | Indexed on `briefing_id` and `document_id`. v0.1.1: add monitoring; v0.2 if >1M rows: partition by user_id. |
| User on free tier exhausts Mistral free fallback during briefing generation | Medium | Briefing generation = 1 LLM call (Q&A pre-baker). Free tier 5 RPM is sufficient. BYOK users unaffected. |

## 14. Out-of-scope decisions (deferred)

- **Briefing edit** post-generation — not in M5. Regenerate is the v0.1 UX.
- **Multiple briefings per consultation** — model supports it (multiple rows per user), UX in M5 is "create new briefing" each time.
- **Briefing template editor** for power users — v0.2+.
- **Briefing analytics** (which sections are most-viewed by shared doctors) — v0.2+ (requires share_links from M6).
- **Multi-language briefing** — v0.1.1 (briefing strings ES only in v0.1, matches spec rev 2 i18n posture).

## 17. Dependencies into M4 and M6

- M5 does NOT block M4 (Apple Health export wizard + Telegram bot). M4 can run in parallel after M5 spec is approved.
- M5 acceptance requires successful M2 entity extraction pipeline (already shipped).
